08190 Sha`ashgaz {shah-ash-gaz'}

波斯語衍生字; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Shaashgaz 1; 1

沙甲 = "美人的僕人"
1) 亞哈隨魯王的太監, 負責掌管女子第二院 (#斯 2:14|)

of Persian derivation;; n pr m

AV - Shaashgaz 1; 1

Shaashgaz = "servant of the beautiful"
1) the eunuch in the palace of Xerxes who was in charge of the women
   in the 2nd house
